name: Interview Prep
description: Add concise interview preparation advice when a reminder or user request is interview-related.
action_template: Before the interview, quickly review company background, the job description, and one STAR example.

name: Sedentary Break
description: Suggest a short exercise when a reminder is related to sitting too long.
action_template: Do a 4-minute reset: wall stand for 1 minute, 20 squats, and 1 minute of neck stretching.

name: Regular Meals
description: Suggest light meal guidance when the user asks about eating.
action_template: Use the simple meal formula: protein, vegetables, and a low-GI staple. Drink warm water first.

name: Short Video Guard
description: Offer an alternative action when the user wants to avoid short-video distraction.
action_template: Focus on the current task for 20 minutes first, then take a 5-minute break.

name: GLM-OCR Image Extraction
description: Use the local GLM-OCR-MNN model for screenshots, receipts, schedules, meeting images, and wireless debugging screenshots. The model performs OCR only; rules or text models extract schedules, todos, or ADB pairing details.
action_template: For image OCR, prefer the local GLM-OCR-MNN path. Keep the OCR prompt short. Log the full OCR text, then parse device name, IP, connect port, pair port, and pair code with deterministic rules when the screenshot is an ADB pairing screen.

name: Markdown Report Workflow
description: When the user asks for reports, PDF, weekly summaries, or shareable documents, create Markdown first, then convert to output files.
action_template: Write complete Markdown first. In python_exec call write_report(markdown_text, "report_name", title="...") to create .md and .html, then call html_to_pdf to create .pdf. Use relative output paths and include every generated file in output_files.

name: Android GUI Sub-Agent
description: When the user asks ActMe to operate phone UI, inspect another app, or complete a cross-app Android task, call gui_agent instead of manually chaining many adb tap commands.
action_template: For UI automation call {"type":"gui_agent","command":"the user's UI goal in concise English","plan":"1. Text-only plan from the cloud/main agent.\n2. Next expected GUI steps.\n3. Include target text to type when needed.","target_text":"exact text to type, if any","guidance":"optional correction after previous GUI result/error","timeout_ms":120000}. The cloud/main agent is the planner and cannot see screenshots; the local GUI agent is the visual executor. If a GUI run returns [GUI_AGENT_ACTION_ERROR], fails, or stalls, inspect its result and call gui_agent again with an updated plan plus concise guidance. The GUI executor forces type actions to use target_text so the visual model cannot guess or rewrite user input. The GUI agent first checks wireless ADB, starts screenshot pairing if needed, captures screenshots, calls local GUI-Owl, maps normalized 0-1000 or absolute coordinates to the actual screenshot size, executes actions, and logs every model input/output and coordinate mapping to logcat.
